description: Change one scene of the scenario without touching the others.

changes.description: Only the fields to change; everything else stays as it is.

ambience.description: Background sound of the place: room tone, office (keyboard, air), studio, kitchen (sizzle, plates), cafe (murmur, cups), beach (waves), park (breeze, birds), city (traffic), night (crickets), rain, booth. Default none.

background.description: Quick ready-made backgrounds when no custom decor is drawn: brand (default shape), plain, pattern, office, home, cafe, city, night, park, studio.

backgroundImage.description: Path to an image used as the scene background (overrides background).

camera.description: Camera move during the scene: push (default), pull, pan, static.

character.description: Where the character stands (content moves to the other side). Default depends on the layout.

colors.description: Colour overrides for this scene only.

decor.description: A decor drawn to measure for this scene, from what the scenario describes (any place: a kitchen, a beach, a market, a lab, a classroom...).

description.description: What the decor shows, in words (for the script and storyboard).

from.description: Reuse the decor of another scene, e.g. "s2".

svg.description: A flat vector illustration drawn for this scene, as SVG on a 1920x1080 stage (viewBox "0 0 1920 1080"; it is scaled to cover vertical and square formats, anchored at the bottom). Use the palette placeholders so the decor follows the identity: {bg} {surface} {surface2} {card} {accent} {accentDeep} {ink} {text} {muted}; other hex colours are allowed for local details (wood, plants, sky). Style: flat shapes, soft rounded corners, no outlines or thin dark strokes only, no gradients unless subtle, no text, no people (the character stands in front). Keep it calm where the content goes and where the character stands (the lower part on the character side, by default the left third for most layouts); put the detail around the edges and the top. Draw the floor or ground near the bottom (around y 900-1080). Only <svg> drawing elements: no scripts, no external images or links.

duration.description: Minimum length in seconds (the scene still lasts as long as its voice).

elements.description: Things drawn to measure for this scene and animated in: objects, screens, charts, maps, signs, food, vehicles... anything the scenario needs.

at.description: When it appears, in seconds from the start of the scene (default: one after the other).

description.description: What it is, e.g. "a phone showing a chat".

layer.description: Behind or in front of the character.

motion.description: Idle movement once it is on screen.

svg.description: A flat vector drawing of one thing, as SVG with a viewBox that fits it tightly (e.g. viewBox="0 0 400 300"). Same style and palette placeholders as decors: {bg} {surface} {surface2} {card} {accent} {accentDeep} {ink} {text} {muted}, plus any hex colour for local details. Short text inside a drawing is allowed (a label on a screen or a sign). No scripts, links or external images.

w.description: Width, in % of the frame width (the height follows the drawing).

x.description: Left edge, in % of the frame width.

y.description: Top edge, in % of the frame height.

icons.description: Icon per onScreenText item, by Lucide name (e.g. "rocket", "calendar", "shield-check", "coffee"). Use "" to skip one.

image.description: Path to an image file (screenshot, photo, product) for layout "showcase".

narration.description: What the character says (spoken text, also used for captions). Delivery markup: *word* stresses a word, "..." adds a hesitation, "—" a short break, "?" and "!" change the intonation.

onScreenText.description: Short texts shown in the visual.

pose.description: Override the pose (default depends on the layout): rest, hello (waving), crossed (arms crossed), point, cheer (arms up).

showCaptions.description: Show the narration as captions (default: yes, except intro and outro).

title.description: Heading of the panel, grid, steps or showcase.

transition.description: How this scene appears: soft (default), fade, slide, zoom, wipe, cut.

visual.description: Short note on what we see (for the storyboard and the person reading the script).

voiceTone.description: How the line is said: neutral, warm, excited, calm, serious, playful, curious, surprised, confident, sad. Default follows the expression (happy → warm, curious → curious, focused → serious, proud → confident, sleepy → calm).

name: update_scene
title: Edit one scene
